title: org.projectfile.ci conformance fixture (v1)
description: Structure of one behavioural conformance vector for the org.projectfile.ci CI-DAG extension. A vector is an INPUT (a CI subtree, optionally composed from an ordered `includes` chain per spec §4.9a) plus the vendor-NEUTRAL behaviour every conforming consumer must produce when it resolves and runs the graph. This meta-schema validates the vector FILES; the `input` (and each `includes` entry) MUST additionally satisfy schema/org.projectfile.ci.v1.json. A consumer (m6e->make, t4n->Tekton, GitHub/Forgejo->workflow) PASSES a vector iff: in accept mode the set of tools it executes for the goals equals `runs`, every `before` ordering holds, every `args` mapping is delivered, and every `counts` multiplicity (the per-cell fan-out a `matrix` produces) matches; in reject mode it refuses to build the graph for the stated reason.

description.description: One-line human statement of the behaviour this vector pins.

includes.description: OPTIONAL ordered include chain. Each entry is a CI subtree; they are deep-merged in order, then `input` is merged on top (base/local wins) per spec §4.9a. Inlined here so the suite is hermetic — no network, deterministic.

input.description: The base document's org.projectfile.ci subtree (the value at org.projectfile.ci). MUST also validate against schema/org.projectfile.ci.v1.json — except that the semantic defect exercised in reject mode (a `needs` cycle) is STRUCTURALLY valid and therefore passes that schema; it is caught only by a resolver.

expect.description: The required outcome. Accept mode carries `runs` (and optionally `before`/`args`); reject mode carries `reject`. The two are mutually exclusive.

runs.description: EXACT set of tool names that execute for the resolved goals (closed world: any tool not listed MUST NOT run). Goals are the nodes flagged `goal: true`, or — when none is flagged — every graph sink. With a `matrix` this is the DISTINCT set; per-cell multiplicity is asserted by `counts`.

counts.description: OPTIONAL per-tool execution multiplicity (default 1 each when omitted). A matrix CELL tool runs once per cell of the `matrix.axes` cartesian product MINUS every cell a `matrix.exclude` entry matches (count = surviving-product cardinality); a SOURCE tool runs once before the cells; a JOIN tool once after every cell. Lets a vector assert the fan-out/fan-in a matrix produces without naming individual cells.

before.description: Ordering constraints over executed tools: each [X, Y] means tool X completes strictly before tool Y starts. The observable guarantee; the lowering (make order-only prerequisite, Tekton runAfter, workflow needs) is the consumer's business.

args.description: Required arg string delivered to a tool's invocation (the {args: "…"} override branch). A consumer's own CLI override may still win at runtime; this asserts the resolved default.

reject.description: The semantic defect a resolver MUST refuse (not catchable by JSON Schema). `cycle`: needs edges between nodes form a loop.
